title: Hitler and the Magenta crash; Nazi saucer tests

tellings.quote: From reports that Hitler knew about the 1933 Magenta Crash to rumors of Nazi saucer tests in modern-day Czechoslovakia

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions reports that Adolf Hitler knew about the Magenta crash, a craft said to have come down near Magenta in northern Italy in 1933. He also points to rumors that Nazi Germany tested flying saucers in what is now the Czech Republic and Slovakia. If true, it would mean governments were studying such craft well before the famous American cases.
